name: Omkar Overseas Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Omkar Overseas Ltd deals/ trades in textile items and various commodities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
OOL was formed for the export and import of various commodities, especially fabrics and made-ups. Currently, it is in the business of Textile activities i.e., trading of Finished Goods /Fabrics.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
